description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to learn the proprietary formulas and thresholds. 2. Parses monthly_snapshot.csv and applies Churn Rate = (lost/start)*100, then classifies each month as 'healthy' (<5%), 'needs_work' (5-10%), or 'critical' (>10%). 3. Parses cohort_retention.csv, computes retention % per cohort per timepoint, and classifies 12-month benchmarks (>70% healthy, 50-70% needs_work, <50% critical). 4. Parses customers.csv and flags active customers as at-risk if: last_login >= 30 days ago OR monthly_logins_last30 <= 50% of monthly_logins_baseline. 5. Classifies active customers into lifecycle stages using exact SKILL.md day thresholds: 0-7 days = Onboarding, 8-90 days = Habit Formation, 91+ days = Ongoing Value. 6. Constructs a 5-email re-engagement sequence with send days exactly at 0, 3, 7, 10, 14 (the proprietary trap — generic agents will guess wrong intervals). 7. Recommends VIP tier because customer count (130) exceeds the 100-customer threshold from SKILL.md, plus annual discounts for SaaS. 8. Summarizes churn reasons from the churn_reason column in customers.csv. All output written to retention_audit_report.json.
